subject: [MAP] Acme POC - environment deps (VPC / IP allowlist / SSO / KMS)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: David Lee <david.lee@acme.com>
Cc: nikhil_sharma@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 05 Jan 2027 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: [MAP] Acme POC - environment deps (VPC / IP allowlist / SSO / KMS)

Hi David / Acme team,

Great to meet today - thanks for the productive discovery call. Per our conversation I attached a draft Mutual Action Plan (MAP) and the initial environment dependency checklist we’ll need to complete the POC. I wanted to summarize the key MAP milestone for the POC environment setup and ask you to confirm owners and target dates so we can lock the schedule.

POC environment setup (milestone: "Provision & validate POC network and auth")
- Target completion: 2027-01-21 (target close date for POC kickoff)
- Responsibilities:
  - Acme IT: VPC peering + route validation; IP allowlist confirmation
  - Acme Security: SSO/SAML metadata exchange + approval
  - Acme DevOps: KMS/secrets provisioning for test keys
  - Redwood: provide VPC peering config, test endpoints, and SSO SAML service provider metadata
- Dependencies: VPC peering acceptance from Acme account, firewall/open ports, SAML metadata exchange, KMS IAM policy for key usage

Open asks for you (please reply inline):
1) Confirm owners for VPC peering, SSO, and KMS (name + email)
2) Any blackout windows for Acme infra teams between Jan 10-24?
3) Do you have a preferred KMS (cloud KMS) or do you need Redwood to host a test key?

Attachments: redwood-map-draft-MAP-v1.xlsx (MAP draft), acme-network-checklist.pdf (network items)

I’ve CC’d Nikhil (network lead) and Jonas (security engineer) from our side to help coordinate technical details. Once you confirm owners we’ll add dates into the MAP and send a short mutual calendar for the milestones.

Thanks,

Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0142
From: David Lee <david.lee@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Sarah Torres <sarah.torres@acme.com>, it@acme.com
Date: Wed, 06 Jan 2027 09:27:00 -0800
Subject: Re: [MAP] Acme POC - environment deps (VPC / IP allowlist / SSO / KMS)

Thanks Marissa - appreciate the summary and the MAP draft. Quick answers inline:

1) Owners:
  - VPC peering / network: Sarah Torres (sarah.torres@acme.com) - Acme Network Lead
  - SSO/SAML: David Lee (david.lee@acme.com) - I’ll own getting metadata to you and routing approvals to Security
  - KMS / secrets: Acme DevOps (devops@acme.com) - primary contact is Raj Patel (raj.patel@acme.com)

2) No planned maintenance windows between Jan 10-24 today; I’ll flag if that changes.

3) Preferred KMS: we use Acme-managed CloudKMS (GCP for this project). We can create a test key and grant Redwood a short-lived service account with IAM permissions for the POC. Can you send the minimal IAM permissions you need?

We’ll get Sarah and Raj looped into the thread. Also, for SSO we’ll need your SAML SP metadata (ACS URL, EntityID) and any certificate info.

Thanks - will share Sarah’s calendar and Raj’s contact details in follow-up.


David Lee
Director of Product, Acme Corp
david.lee@acme.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: nikhil_sharma@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com
Cc: David Lee <david.lee@acme.com>, Sarah Torres <sarah.torres@acme.com>
Date: Thu, 07 Jan 2027 10:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: [MAP] Acme POC - environment deps (VPC / IP allowlist / SSO / KMS)

Thanks David - that sounds good. Nikhil / Jonas, please see Acme owners above and help confirm the exact artifacts they’ll need. Action items for our side:

- Nikhil: prepare VPC peering spec (VPC IDs, ASN if relevant, required CIDR ranges, expected route tables, and test IPs). Also include the IP ranges we’ll ask them to allowlist for control-plane and test endpoints. Target to send spec: 2027-01-09 EOD.
- Jonas: prepare SAML SP metadata (ACS URL, EntityID, cert thumbprint) + short SSO integration guide. Confirm whether Redwood needs SP-initiated or IdP-initiated flow for the POC. Target to send: 2027-01-10 EOD.
- Marissa (me): coordinate MAP updates and schedule the 30-min handoff call for Jan 12 with Acme IT + DevOps to walk through the checklist.

David/Sarah - will Nikhil need any network ACLs or tenant IDs from your side to complete the peering template? If so please share the numeric IDs (VPC, project/account) privately or via the Drive link.

I’ve attached a small VPC template that has the fields we typically request.

Thanks,
Marissa
From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.com>
To: David Lee <david.lee@acme.com>, Sarah Torres <sarah.torres@acme.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, jonas_weber@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 08 Jan 2027 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: [MAP] Acme POC - environment deps (VPC / IP allowlist / SSO / KMS)

Quick update from the Redwood network/security side - thanks for confirming owners. Summary and proposed dates:

- VPC peering: Nikhil will send the peering template (includes VPC IDs, route table notes) by 2027-01-09 EOD. We request acceptance + final route validation from Acme by 2027-01-14.
- IP allowlist: we will provide the list of control-plane and test IPs (10 addresses) with expected ports (443, 22 for troubleshooting) by 2027-01-09. Acme to apply and confirm by 2027-01-14.
- SSO/SAML: Jonas to send SP metadata by 2027-01-10. Acme to return IdP metadata and test account by 2027-01-17.
- KMS/secrets: If you create a test key in GCP CloudKMS and add a service account for redwood-poc@redwood-svc.iam.gserviceaccount.com with 'cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter' for the test key, we’ll validate secrets flow by 2027-01-17. If Acme prefers Redwood-hosted test key, we can provide that by 2027-01-13.

Next steps:
1) Acme confirms the acceptance timeline and shares VPC/project IDs (reply-all or upload to the Drive folder).
2) We’ll lock dates in the MAP and send calendar invites for the Jan 12 handoff and Jan 18 validation window.

If any of the dates are problematic (e.g., planned maintenance), we can shift the MAP but would like a two-week window to hit the POC kickoff by Jan 21 as proposed.

Thanks - I’ll attach the peering template in a follow-up email.

Nikhil Sharma
Network Engineer | Redwood Inference
